t: 英国人在美索不达米亚战役中从奥斯曼人手中夺取了纳西里亚.
te: The British capture Nasiriyah from the Ottomans during the Mesopotamian campaign.

dz: RFC队长拉诺·霍克(Lanoe Hawker)成为第一位获得维多利亚十字勋章的英国追逐机飞行员.
de: RFC Captain Lanoe Hawker becomes the first British pursuit aviator to earn the Victoria Cross.

t: 美国开始了对海地长达19年的占领.
te: The United States begins a 19-year occupation of Haiti.
dz: 美国开始了对海地长达19年的占领.
de: The United States begins a 19-year occupation of Haiti.

t: 帕特里克·皮尔斯 (Patrick Pearse) 在都柏林奥多诺万·罗萨 (O'Donova…

dz: 帕特里克·皮尔斯 (Patrick Pearse) 在都柏林奥多诺万·罗萨 (O'Donovan Rossa) 葬礼上发表了著名演讲“不自由的爱尔兰永远不会和平”。
de: Patrick Pearse gives his famous speech "Ireland unfree shall never be at peace" at O'Donovan Rossa's funeral in Dublin.

t: 德国第12集团军在1915年高利采-塔恩诺夫进攻和大撤退期间占领了华沙.
te: The German 12th Army occupies Warsaw during the Gorlice–Tarnów Offensive and the Great Retreat of 1915.
dz: 第一次世界大战:德国第12集团军在1915年高利采-塔恩诺夫进攻和大撤退期间占领了华沙.
de: World War I: The German 12th Army occupies Warsaw during the Gorlice–Tarnów Offensive and the Great Retreat of 1915.

t: 萨里·拜尔之战:盟军发动了分道扬镳的攻击,时间恰好与盟军在苏弗拉湾登陆的主要援军同时.
te: Battle of Sari Bair: The Allies mount a diversionary attack timed to coincide with a major Allied landing of reinforcem…
dz: 第一次世界大战:萨里·拜尔之战:盟军发动了分道扬镳的攻击,时间恰好与盟军在苏弗拉湾登陆的主要援军同时.
de: World War I: Battle of Sari Bair: The Allies mount a diversionary attack timed to coincide with a major Allied landing of reinforcements at Suvla Bay.

t: 纽约"世界报"的一则报道透露,德意志帝国政府从托马斯·爱迪生那里购买了多余的苯酚,可以用来为战…
te: A story in the New York World newspaper reveals that the Imperial German government had purchased excess phenol from Th…
dz: 纽约"世界报"的一则报道透露,德意志帝国政府从托马斯·爱迪生那里购买了多余的苯酚,可以用来为战争努力制造炸药并转用于拜耳生产阿司匹林.
de: A story in the New York World newspaper reveals that the Imperial German government had purchased excess phenol from Thomas Edison that could be used to make explosives for the war effort and diverted it to Bayer for aspirin production.

t: 一场四级飓风袭击了德克萨斯州加尔维斯顿,阵风时速为135英里(217公里/小时).
te: A Category 4 hurricane hits Galveston, Texas with winds at 135 miles per hour (217 km/h).
dz: 一场四级飓风袭击了德克萨斯州加尔维斯顿,阵风时速为135英里(217公里/小时).
de: A Category 4 hurricane hits Galveston, Texas with winds at 135 miles per hour (217 km/h).

t: 犹太裔美国人利奥·弗兰克在美国乔治亚州玛丽埃塔被州长约翰·斯莱顿减刑后被私刑处死.

dz: 犹太裔美国人利奥·弗兰克在美国乔治亚州玛丽埃塔被州长约翰·斯莱顿减刑后被私刑处死.
de: Jewish American Leo Frank is lynched in Marietta, Georgia, USA after his death sentence is commuted by Governor John M. Slaton.

dz: 美国海军打捞潜水员升起F-4,这是美国第一艘潜艇在事故中被击沉.
de: US Navy salvage divers raise F-4, the first U.S. submarine sunk in an accident.

te: The pacifist Zimmerwald Conference begins.
dz: 和平主义者齐默瓦尔德会议开始.
de: The pacifist Zimmerwald Conference begins.

t: 由William Foster & Co.为英国军队所开发的第一辆坦克原型车已经完工并给出了它…

dz: 第一次世界大战:由William Foster & Co.为英国军队所开发的第一辆坦克原型车已经完工并给出了它的第一次试验驱动.
de: World War I: The first tank prototype, developed by William Foster & Co. for the British army, is completed and given its first test drive.

t: 法国士兵营救被困在穆萨道格的4000多亚美尼亚种族灭绝幸存者.

dz: 法国士兵营救被困在穆萨道格的4000多亚美尼亚种族灭绝幸存者.

de: New Culture Movement: Chen Duxiu establishes the New Youth magazine in Shanghai.

te: The Saturday Evening Post publishes the short story "Extricating Young Gussie" by P.G. Wodehouse, featuring the first a…
dz: "星期六晚报"出版短篇故事"Exclusing Young Gussie"由P.G. Wodehouse出品,以伯蒂·伍斯特和他的侍从杰维斯为主角,首次出道.
de: The Saturday Evening Post publishes the short story "Extricating Young Gussie" by P.G. Wodehouse, featuring the first appearance of Bertie Wooster and his valet Jeeves.

te: The Second Battle of Champagne begins.
dz: 第一次世界大战：第二次香槟之战开始。

de: World War I: Radoje Ljutovac becomes the first soldier in history to shoot down an enemy aircraft with ground-to-air fire.

t: 奥匈帝国和德国同盟国联合起来，在最近加入的保加利亚的支持下，在奥古斯特·冯·马肯森的指挥下对塞…

dz: 第一次世界大战：奥匈帝国和德国同盟国联合起来，在最近加入的保加利亚的支持下，在奥古斯特·冯·马肯森的指挥下对塞尔维亚发动了新的攻势。
de: World War I: Combined Austro-Hungarian and German Central Powers, reinforced by the recently joined Bulgaria, launch a new offensive against Serbia under command of August von Mackensen.
